Implementation Plan

## Implementation plan: rewrite `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` (canary content update)

Planning ref: `main` @ `c4c4f740fba949f3c873b35fdb8c2654ab14420b`. The integration-branch mismatch line reads `unknown`, not `true`, so this plan is not blocked on it.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt
Scope-mode justification: The issue fully specifies the result: one existing file must end up holding exactly three given lines. No helper, workflow, test or doc needs to change. The issue forbids touching any other file, so this is a straight content overwrite of the existing canary. No new script, scheduler wiring, supervisor or registry entry is involved (§20). The complete fix and the shortcut are the same edit, so the §6 completeness rule (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed) is met with no extra cost.

## Files likely to change
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`

## Functions or modules to implement
None. This is a static text file change.

## Automation / scheduler surface (§20.E)
- No new or extended script. Only an existing data file changes.
- No scheduler or PR-push wiring changes.
- No long-running supervisor.
- No database work.
- No entry needed in the scripts-pending-removal registry.

## Data structures affected
The file currently holds two lines: `status: ok` and `decompose-run: 40427433026`, with no trailing newline. After the change it must hold exactly these three lines:
```
status: ok
run_id: alt-40982514785
updated-by: ai-pipeline
```
The `decompose-run:` line is removed.

## API or interface changes
None.

## Decisions
### D1 — Trailing newline handling
- Chosen: end the file with a single trailing newline after `updated-by: ai-pipeline` (POSIX text-file convention), with LF line endings and no blank lines.
- Alternatives considered: keep the current no-trailing-newline style; add extra blank lines.
- Why: "Exactly three lines" is most safely read as three newline-terminated lines. Extra blank lines would break "exactly". No repo code reads this file in a way that depends on the trailing newline.

### D2 — Replace instead of append
- Chosen: overwrite the whole file content.
- Alternatives considered: keep `decompose-run:` and add the new lines.
- Why: the issue requires the content to be exactly the three given lines.

## Security considerations
- No trust boundary, endpoint, credential or external input is involved.
- The content is static and contains no secrets.
- Abuse case: an editor model widens scope to other files. The issue forbids touching any other file, so review should reject any diff outside this one file.

## Risks and edge cases
- Conflict note: the file's current second line (`decompose-run: 40427433026`) does not match the target. This is expected because the file is being replaced, not a blocker.
- Do not add CRLF line endings, a BOM, or trailing whitespace.
- Do not add a changelog, agents fragment or test edits, since the issue allows only this one file.

## Testing considerations
- Check the result with `cat -A tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`. It should show exactly `status: ok$`, `run_id: alt-40982514785$` and `updated-by: ai-pipeline$`.
- `git diff --stat` should list only `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`.
- No test suite changes are needed.

## Pre-execution self-check
- The answers were interpreted: the auto-answer means no clarification was needed.
- The single file is named and the target content is exact.
- The plan stays within the "only modify this file" constraint.
